executeSQLs: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ppp DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `game_records` (`id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `nickname` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, `score` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `cleared` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `level_reached` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `elapsed_seconds` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `created_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `idx_score` (`score`), KEY `idx_created_at` (`created_at`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
